rationale: This plan comprehensively addresses the fraud exploration task objective. Load tables provides baseline manifest review; class_prevalence quantifies the fraud flag distribution and imbalance. Feature_comparison examines 17 claim and member characteristics (excluding the label-derived fraud_pattern_type) to identify differences between flagged and unflagged claims. Leakage_assessment flags label-derived and protected fields for transparency. Write_report documents the analysis with four caveats: synthetic data origin, descriptive interpretation only, associations not causal claims, and class imbalance awareness; show_denominators ensures rates are explicit (numerator/denominator format); cite_artifacts provides reproducibility via source citations.
